name: FP&A analyst
summary: Builds budgets, forecasts and financial models and explains why the numbers moved. Shows the owner where cash will be and which inputs matter most.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 27 sources (US, UK and EU reporting changes, plus official sources for India, Canada and Australia), four skills (13-week cash forecast, variance analysis, driver-based model, SaaS metrics pack), five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs.
